title: Abijam and Asa in Jerusalem
reflectionText: Asa removes idols and brings dedicated gifts into Yahweh’s house, while the high places remain. Abijam’s reign carries a different judgment, yet David’s sake is remembered there too. What stands out as you hear these particular deeds beside the words about each king’s heart?
